images.alt: Helicopter aerial view showing a massive warehouse fire at the Medline Industries distribution center with thick black smoke billowing across the sky in Tracy, California.
images.caption: LiveCopter footage shows the scale of the Medline warehouse fire, with black smoke visible for miles across California's Central Valley.
images.credit: KPIX/CBS News Bay Area via KCRA 3

images.alt: A massive plume of black smoke rises from the Medline warehouse fire, visible across the Tracy, California skyline as the fire continues to burn.
images.caption: The smoke plume from the Medline fire remained visible for days, raising air quality concerns for communities across San Joaquin County.
